text: Healthy living means taking care of your body and mind. One important part is eating a balanced diet with plenty of fruit, vegetables, and whole grains, while avoiding too much sugar and fast food. Regular exercise, like walking or swimming, keeps your body strong and reduces stress. Getting enough sleep is also essential, because it helps you recover and think clearly. Mental health matters just as much, so make time to relax and talk to friends. Finally, try to keep a good work-life balance, so you don't feel tired or worried all the time. Small daily habits can make a big difference.
